project.name: project3-work-log
project.summary: A terminal CSV work log creates timestamped tasks, searches stored rows and pages results. Edit/delete are placeholders and regex search is defective. No HTTP routes.

nodes.label: Task capture and menus
nodes.summary: run_program creates a CSV header if absent; menus prompt for a task, minutes and optional notes.

nodes.label: Local CSV persistence
nodes.summary: Entries are appended to a working-directory CSV and read back by DictReader; no actual records are included.

nodes.label: Search and paging
nodes.summary: Date, minutes and task-name searches scan rows; results page through display_entries.

nodes.label: Project reference and license
nodes.summary: Original course documentation and any upstream license remain separate from executable processing.
